describes: the Stage A analysis layer's products: what is written, where, stored or derived, under which lattice and class map. It does not replace vop_interwoven/metrics/manifest/metrics_manifest.v1.json, which describes the geometry path and is unchanged.
naming_rule: every field names the observed quantity (px, ink_px, black_px, model_ink_under_px, cells_with_ink). Nothing here judges a drawing, a model or progress; where a number could be read as a verdict, its denominator is stated beside it.

lattice.origin_rule: origin_uv[k] = floor(crop_min_uv[k] / cell_ft) * cell_ft, per axis
lattice.pixel_rule: a pixel belongs to the cell containing its centre

class_map.rule: every kinds record and the roll-up record the sha256 they used; a roll-up leaves class columns empty for a derivation made under another map

products.name: dense channels (model_*, anno_*, model_ink_under_*)
products.derivation: per-cell pixel counts by channel; a pixel belongs to the cell holding its centre (G-5)

products.name: crop_a_px
products.derivation: model pixel centres inside crop A (and its split bands) per cell (W1)

products.name: inside_crop_a
products.derivation: crop A's cells holding a model pixel centre; for a split crop, cells whose centre is in a band

products.name: occupancy
products.derivation: empty / model_only / anno_only / overlap from the ink counts (item 3)

products.name: element x cell accounting (ec_*)
products.derivation: per (key, cell): ec_px: the key's pixels in the cell; ec_ink_px: the key's ink pixels (item 3: a 4-neighbour of a different colour); a filled region's ink, not its area; ec_black_px: annotation keys: black pixels assigned to the element (smallest containing bbox); 0 for model keys; ec_model_ink_under_px: annotation key: model ink pixels under the element's own pixels and its assigned black; model key: the key's ink pixels under ANY annotation (element | black_assigned)

products.name: class arrays (<family>__<class>__<field>)
products.kind: derived and stored in a separate file
products.derivation: ec rows summed per cell by the class the map gives each key's kind; annotation occupancy_px = ink + black + area if a filled region

products.name: legacy_source_partition_8 (array) / channel_shape_legacy
products.derivation: kinds.legacy_channel_shape over the grid's dense arrays

products.name: legacy_anno_partition (AnnoFinalCells_*)
products.derivation: dominant(legacy_bucket, occupancy_px) over annotation-present cells; ties to the class map's declared order

invariants.expr: for each layer and field, sum of ec rows per cell == the grid's dense channel(s) in that cell (model element/DWG/link px and ink; annotation px, ink, assigned black; model ink under annotation)
sum(ec_model_ink_under_px over annotation keys) == sum(over model keys) == model_ink_under_anno (one annotation owner per covered pixel)
for each family and field, sum over classes per cell == the grid's dense channel; annotation occupancy_px == anno_element_ink + anno_filled_region + anno_black_assigned
ExtFinalCells_Any == DWG + RVT - DWG_RVT (as in v1)
W1 changes binning, never a pixel count

rollup_columns.empty_cell: not applicable (row status, no derivation, another class map, no registered annotation), never 0

TotalCells.note: v1: the geometry raster's W x H (crop A, annotation-expanded on some views, sheet-capped on others). Stage A: the cells inside crop A on the view-UV lattice.

AnnoPresentFinal.note: v1: cells with a final anno_key, over the categories the geometry path collected. Stage A: cells the annotation occupancy rule marks (every view-owned element painted, plus datums, view markers, revision clouds, assigned black, filled-region area).

AnnoFinalCells_TEXT.note: v1: one type per cell from the cell's FINAL anno_key (last writer: draw-order dependent). Stage A: one type per cell by dominant(legacy_bucket, occupancy_px), ties to the class map's declared order: deterministic. Bucket rules reproduce classify_annotation by category; spot dimensions and tag categories outside its list fall to OTHER as they did.

notes: A4, VERIFIED against the code (vop_interwoven/metrics/final_state_scanner.py, core/raster.py, pipeline._compute_manifest_metrics_payload): the pipeline scans with model_presence_mode='any'; has_model = has_model_present(idx,'any') (occ OR edge OR proxy) OR occ_host OR occ_link OR occ_dwg, and every source of ext (an edge key or proxy key whose element_meta source is DWG/LINK, occ_dwg, occ_link) is one of those terms. So Ext was a sub-flag of Model and Cells_ExtOnly / Cells_AnnoExt were structurally 0 -- exactly, not approximately. Under model_presence_mode='occ' they are not (an edge-only DWG cell is ExtOnly); tests/test_stage_a_kinds.py pins both.

A3: the geometry path's AnnoFinalCells_* was a partition (one type per cell, from the cell's final anno_key, i.e. the last writer), invariant anno_types_sum_to_anno_present. The Stage A partition is dominant-by-px over occupancy_px, ties to a declared order: deterministic where last-writer was order-dependent.

A5: a view-owned DWG appears on the ANNOTATION layer under Stage A (decision D1) but was counted as Model + Ext in the geometry path. It is folded into neither: annotation_class import_view_owned, legacy bucket IMPORT_VIEW_OWNED (not a v1 bucket). The disposition is Greg's and is open.
Link pixels are colour-per-category: per-element link identity is not captured (ledger M1), so link keys are one per linked category.
No view basis is captured: a moved or rotated section/elevation cannot be told from a crop edit; a cross-run tool must flag, not assume.
